caption: The drawing depicts a single large, rectangular trunk set against a plain, cream-colored background. The trunk is rendered in shades of light brown and tan, giving it a leather and wood appearance. The front and side panels are framed with lines that suggest wooden construction. The trunk features metallic elements such as a large central lock and latch on the front, two buckles with leather straps on the top and sides, and several smaller metal fixtures and studs along the edges and corners, which are painted with muted gold and brass tones. The trunk also displays reinforced corners with additional studs. The left side of the trunk, facing outward, is marked with the word "KEANE" in small, uppercase letters. The trunk casts a soft shadow beneath it, creating the impression that it is suspended above the ground. There are no additional objects or decorative details in the surrounding area. The artist's name, "FRANK KEANE," is written in small, faint letters in the bottom left corner of the white background.
title: Horse Hide Trunk
